competitors.name: New Jersey grocery retailers / delivery platforms
competitors.action: Supermarket News reported that New Jersey passed the Fair Price Protection Act, becoming the second state to ban surveillance pricing for essential food products. The law also places a one-year moratorium on installing new digital price tags, increasing regulatory scrutiny of individualized grocery pricing and electronic shelf-label rollouts.

competitors.name: Supermarket operators / A2Z Cust2Mate
competitors.action: Progressive Grocer reported A2Z Cust2Mate research showing physical supermarkets are underdelivering on shopper expectations for fast trips, transparent pricing, timely rewards and connected in-store experiences. The report found 68% of shoppers value real-time pricing, discounts and basket visibility, while 48% believe supermarkets deliver it effectively.

competitors.name: So Good So You
competitors.action: Progressive Grocer reported that So Good So You named Jennifer Jorgensen CEO after Bansk Group acquired a majority stake in the B Corp-certified wellness-shot and functional-beverage brand. Jorgensen previously spent 26 years at General Mills and led Back to Nature through distribution, innovation and margin expansion work.

trends.topic: Grocery execution is tightening around pricing transparency, shopper trust and professionalized CPG scaling
trends.magnitude: New Jersey became the second state to ban surveillance pricing; A2Z Cust2Mate found a 20-point gap between shoppers wanting real-time price visibility and supermarkets delivering it; So Good So You installed a former General Mills and Back to Nature operator as CEO after majority investment.
trends.context: For Real Dough, premium freezer placement needs clear shelf pricing, promotion accuracy and disciplined retail execution. Emerging CPG brands are also bringing in large-company operators earlier as they move from founder-led growth to scaled distribution.

breaking.headline: New Jersey becomes second state to ban surveillance pricing
breaking.impact: Pricing technology and personalization in grocery are facing more legal limits, making transparent item pricing and promotion mechanics more important for brands and retail partners.

breaking.headline: Supermarkets Falling Short of Shopper Expectations: Report
breaking.impact: Shopper friction around pricing visibility, missed promotions and checkout speed can weaken conversion for premium freezer items unless the value cue is simple and visible at shelf.

breaking.headline: So Good So You Taps CPG Expert as CEO
breaking.impact: Investor-backed emerging food and beverage brands are adding big-CPG operators to manage distribution, innovation and margin discipline, raising the execution bar for challenger brands.
